description: This file sets up and starts the backend server for a real-time cloud dashboard application, using Express.js and Socket.IO. It configures middleware for security, CORS, logging, rate limiting, and health checks. It defines routes for authentication, user management, and metrics, and initializes socket connections, database, and admin user.

classes.name: SocketIOServer
classes.description: The Socket.IO server class used to create real-time communication channels over WebSocket.

methods.name: bootstrap()
methods.description: Main asynchronous function that initializes the express app, middleware, routes, socket server, database connection, and default admin user, then starts listening on the configured port.
